sequential_dependency.intermediate: The transformed query grid before any comparison with the original query.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the demonstrated operation and apply it to the query panel, producing the complete transformed panel.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Compare that transformed intermediate cellwise with the query and paint changed cells with the empty slot frame color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The mask has no changed-cell locations until the input-dependent operation has produced the transformed query.
